about.heading: About Villa Memorial Park
about.story: A family-run memorial park in Isabela City, Basilan — founded on the belief that every life deserves a resting place of beauty and peace, and that the families who love them deserve honesty, warmth and time.
about.mission: To walk beside every family with honesty and warmth — clear guidance, dignified care and no hidden costs, whether the need is today or years from now.
about.vision: A park where remembrance becomes a source of comfort — serene grounds, honest planning and a community that honors every life.

services.heading: Services in full detail
services.intro: Every service below is a full editorial section — what happens, what it includes, and how to begin. Click any one for its full page.

items.title: Death at home
items.tagline: You should not manage the next steps alone.
body: When a loved one passes at home, our coordinators arrange transport, dignified preparation, and guide you through the service options that fit your family — at your pace, with no pressure.

items.title: Death at hospital
items.tagline: We liaise with the facility, you focus on your family.
body: We coordinate directly with the hospital so you are not left to manage paperwork and transport alone. A coordinator takes the next steps in care from there.

items.title: Retrieval & delivery
items.tagline: Part of the complete Villa Memorial Plan.
body: Retrieval of the deceased to the morgue and delivery in casket — good for the first 25 km only — handled with care and respect.

items.title: Preparation & casketing
body: Embalming with make-up and dressing. The type of coffin differs per plan — Bronze, Silver or Gold — each with elegant handles and beautiful interiors.

items.title: Viewing equipment & rites
items.tagline: State-of-the-art, classy equipment for the wake.
body: Lights, curtains and carpets arranged with care, so the family can gather in a space that feels calm and dignified. All packages include free flowers and a tarpaulin.

items.title: Interment
items.tagline: Several cars ready to bring your loved one home.
body: The final journey is conducted with dignity — several cars are ready to bring the deceased to its final resting place in the park.
bullets: Final resting place in the park

plans.heading: Memorial plans & garden lots
plans.intro: Choose what fits your family — every card shows a real photo, a name and an honest price from the 2026 list. Admin adds as many plans as he wants here.
plans.note: Prices shown are the regular "lot only" selling prices and the Villa Memorial Plan monthly rate from the 2026 price list. Senior, installment and interment options are on each plan page.
